From 2025Q2 the FR Y-9 files stop writing a zero for this foreign-office item when the holding company has no foreign offices: across 2025Q1 -> 2025Q2 the share of filers with a NON-ZERO value is unchanged (0.06-0.07) while the share reporting a zero falls from ~0.93 to ~0.10 (measured on all three affected columns; no other column shows the signature). Same rule as the Call Report's 2005Q3 items (maintainer, 2026-09-22): a blank below the reporting threshold that is not discernible from the bank's other items is zero, and dropping those rows biases sums across the change. Not filled where the holding company reports the item in another quarter of the year or where no filer of its tier reports it that quarter.
